description: Create or update a KAZM listener profile. Returns a listener_id that persists across AI sessions — saves name, location, language, and favorite genres so any future AI session can deliver a fully personalized Mellow Mountain Radio experience without starting from scratch.

location.description: City and country, e.g. 'Berlin, Germany' or 'Los Angeles, CA'
